watches.name: Grand Tour integrated steel bracelet

watches.description: The Grand Tour IV has a case diameter of 38,2 mm, which is a beautiful and versatile size. The case is made from 316L stainless steel, and available in either natural steel or with a black PVD coating. The watch features 3 sub dials with a 15 minute counter, perfect for timing those intervals, a 12 hour counter, which should be enough to keep track of your riding time, and lastly running seconds. The main second hand in the center is a 60 second chronograph. The watch is powered by a rhodium plated Swiss made Sellita SW511 movement, with automatic winding. The FKM rubber strap gives the watch a sporty look, and makes it comfortable both on and off the bike, while the Milanese mesh and the black perforated leather strap makes it more dressy. Each watch is hand built to order in Båstad, Sweden, with an estimated lead time of 2 weeks. watches.name: Team Heritage - PEU
watches.description: The design of the PEU revolves around the iconic pattern of Peugeot, the renowned French team ranked as the most successful in history, with notable riders including Eddy Merckx, Robert Millar, Charly Gaul, Walter Godefroot, and Tom Simpson. With its iconic checkerboard pattern, the team has become synonymous with cycling history, and the jersey acted as the team's trademark from 1963 to 1986. The black squares of the hour indices and the small section of a checker pattern at the 12H index, provide a strong character and maximize legibility when reading the time. The indices stand on a discreet green frame, a nod to the BP logo that appeared on the shoulder of the team jersey between 1956 to 1975. At the center of the dial, an embossed checker pattern plays with shadows and highlights. The PEU is a great all-rounder with a design inspired by a deep racing history. Each watch is hand built to order in Båstad, Sweden, with an estimated lead time of 2 weeks. watches.name: Team Heritage - MER
watches.description: With its unique coloured dial, featuring the distinct purple and yellow of the iconic Mercier jersey, the MER is a prominent addition to the series. The French team, founded in 1933, holds the record for the highest number of participations in Tour de France history and was known for having one of the most popular riders of the time on the team, Raymond Poulidor. The iconic coloring, seen from the early 1950s until 1969, reinforces the varying surface structures made up of a ring with a radial brush, paired with a heavy frosted surface. The yellow accent color, found on the team jersey sleeves and collar, is represented in the chamfered chapter ring, while the hour indices are made from thick Super-LumiNova color applied to the face, making it glow brightly in the dark. The MER is exclusively available in a steel case. Each watch is hand built to order in Båstad, Sweden, with an estimated lead time of 2 weeks.
